newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong taxi driver left holding the baby.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong taxi driver left holding the baby.

text.p: A nanny left a Hong Kong taxi driver with more than a tip when his taxi sped off with her charge, a six-month-old baby, on its back seat, a newspaper reported on Wednesday.
The driver discovered his young passenger when the next customer swung open the door and found the seat already occupied by the sleeping infant, the South China Morning Post said.
The New Zealand child minder, who gave her name only as Nick, had got out of the cab and taken the baby's stroller, only to see the taxi driver speed away in search of a new fare, the newspaper said.
Baby Max was reunited an hour later with the nanny and American parents Julie and Martin after the driver took the baby to a police station. The family declined to give their surnames.
"I was extremely upset...I'm paid to look after the baby and to keep him safe," said Nick, who was taking Max to visit his mother's office when the mishap occurred.
